title: Is It a Couch or a Sofa? (2/2)
titleZh: 沙發到底叫 couch 還是 sofa？（2/2）
summaryZh: 說明 sofa 一詞的正式語感，以及家具業偏好用它的原因。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Ask a Teacher

sentences.text: And sofas might sound as though they are more costly and refined than couches.
sentences.zh: 而且 sofa 聽起來可能比 couch 更貴、更講究一些。

sentences.text: It is worth noting that some industries only use the word sofa.
sentences.zh: 值得一提的是，有些行業只會用 sofa 這個字。

sentences.text: That includes furniture, designers, makers, and sellers, as well as home decorators.
sentences.zh: 包括家具設計師、製造商、銷售人員，還有室內佈置的專業人士。

sentences.text: And that's Ask a Teacher for this week.
sentences.zh: 本週的《問老師》就到這裡。
